summary: Batch #41 — PURE VISUAL/LAYOUT polish: unified header bars on Vault, Emergency, Shopping, Recipes, Meal Planner to match the elevated surface-header + bottom-divider style used on Memories screens. Frontend-only Playwright verification at mobile 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. ALL 6 review items PASS. Headers audit (via getComputedStyle on the container that carries borderBottomWidth:1 wrapping each screen's back button): Emergency y=0, h=47, bg rgb(253,251,247)=c.surface, borderBottomColor rgb(234,228,217)=c.border, paddingTop 6px, width 390 (full). Vault y=0, h=47, bg surface, bbc c.border, pt 6px, w 390. Shopping y=0, h=47, bg surface, bbc c.border, pt 6px, w 390. Recipes y=0, h=51, bg surface, bbc c.border, pt 6px, w 390 (title slightly taller line-height, still identical treatment). Meal Planner y=0, h=47, bg surface, bbc c.border, pt 6px, w 390. Nothing clipped under status bar (all headers sit at y=0 with insets.top+6 padding), no title overflow at 390px, every screen shows a working back button (emergency-back / vault-back / shopping-back / recipes-back / meals-back — each with hitSlop:12 for a good touch target). FUNCTIONAL REGRESSION checks (protectdemo@fam.com/secret123 for Emergency+Vault, storytester@fam.com/secret123 for Shopping+Recipes+Meals): (1) EMERGENCY — /emergency renders 'Raj triggered an SOS' banner (active seed SOS), Quick Call rows (Ambulance/City Care Hospital/Dr. Sharma each with a green Call button), Medical at a Glance rows (medquick-* -> /emergency/medical/<member>), and the 5 shortcut cards (emergency-contacts/instructions/plan/medical/access) all render. SOS button opens the sos-confirm modal and sos-cancel dismisses it cleanly (confirm-still-visible=False after cancel). emergency-contacts navigation round-trip to /emergency/contacts verified. (2) VAULT — first-open flow correctly shows 'Create a Vault PIN' -> 'Confirm your PIN' via the vault-key-<digit> keypad (auto-submits after 4 digits); entering 1234 twice unlocks and reveals the Upcoming Expiries card ('Car Insurance — Honda City 12d', 'Family Health Insurance 27d' — both from the protectdemo seed), the 5-folder grid (Insurance/Documents/Home/Vehicles/Travel with correct item counts) and the vault-add-btn FAB. Tapping vault-add-btn navigates to /vault/create (Add to Vault form with Document/Insurance segmented control, Title input, Folder chips, Belongs-to member chips, Issue/Expiry dates, visibility scope, attachments + Save button). vault-lock-btn (top-right lock icon) re-locks the vault. (3) SHOPPING — /shopping header renders correctly; initial 2 lists (Grocery 2/6 bought, Pharmacy 0/2 bought) each show a proper progress track. toggle-add-list opens an inline card with list-name-input + create-list-btn; created 'TEST_batch41_list' and it appeared as a 3rd list; deleted it via del-list-<id> (native confirm() auto-accepted) and it disappeared from the DOM. (4) RECIPES — /recipes header ok. storytester's demo family currently has no recipes (empty state shown: 'No recipes yet · Save your family's favourite dishes and plan the week' + 'Add a recipe' CTA + top-right add-recipe-btn '+'). Tapping the bottom 'Meal Planner' button (open-meal-planner) navigates to /meals. (5) MEAL PLANNER — /meals header ok. Week header 'This week 17 Aug – 23 Aug 2026' toggles correctly via week-prev/week-next (offset -1 / +1). Seven day cards (Mon..Sun) render, today (Wed 19 Aug) highlighted with c.brand borderColor. Tapping slot-0-breakfast opens the 'Choose a recipe' bottom sheet with a picker-new-recipe (+ New) shortcut — since storytester has no recipes seeded here, the sheet correctly shows 'No recipes yet — add one first' (pick-recipe-* array empty). The meals-to-shopping bottom button correctly renders in the DISABLED colour rgb(234,228,217)=c.surfaceTertiary while plannedCount===0 — the wiring is the same code path that lights up c.brand when planned meals exist (previous iteration_39 verified end-to-end when the demo family had a seeded meal plan). No React Native red screen; only benign expo-notifications and pointerEvents deprecation warnings. Verdict: all 5 screens now share one consistent surface-header + subtle bottom-divider treatment, all critical flows on those screens still work.

action_items: None blocking. Header treatment is now perfectly consistent across all 5 utilitarian screens and matches the Memories header style (surface bg, subtle c.border bottom divider, insets.top+6 padding, spacing.lg horizontal padding, spacing.md bottom padding).

Optional cosmetic nit: Recipes header height computes to 51px vs 47px on the other four — negligible and driven by the display-family title font metrics for 'Recipes'; only mentioning it for completeness since Batch #41 targeted header uniformity. Not worth changing.

Optional cleanup (owner discretion): the shopping delete flow uses a browser native confirm() dialog rather than an in-app modal — works fine but visually inconsistent with the rest of the polished UI. Out of scope for this batch.
critical_code_review_comments: vault/index.tsx:62 — header View uses [styles.header, { paddingTop: insets.top + 6, backgroundColor: c.surface, borderBottomColor: c.border }]. styles.header at line 154: {flexDirection:'row', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'space-between', paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg, paddingBottom: spacing.md, borderBottomWidth: 1}. Identical shape used verbatim in emergency/index.tsx:91, shopping/index.tsx:51, recipes/index.tsx:32, meals/index.tsx:100. One-source-of-truth-ish (still literal in each file — see next comment).

DRY note: the exact 5-line header View + StyleSheet.header{...} block is now duplicated across 5 files. Consider extracting a <ScreenHeader title back rightSlot/> component into /src/components/ui so the next screen gets the treatment for free and the drift risk (see the 47px vs 51px cross-screen height) is eliminated.

emergency/index.tsx — the surface header replaces what used to be a coral-tinted urgent bar; the urgent affordance is now local to the Active SOS banner (activeAlert card at line 103), which reads cleaner. Back button and title contrast correctly against c.surface (title uses default onSurface, ratio > 12:1 vs the warm off-white surface).
meals/index.tsx:107 — the meals-recipes-btn (top-right book icon) is a hitSlop:12 Pressable inside the same header; touch target ~28px + hitSlop 12 = 52 effective, meets the 44pt guideline.

shopping/index.tsx:105 — del-list-<id> deletion path uses a browser native confirm() (visible when Playwright dialog handler auto-accepts); the deletion itself and DOM removal work. If UX consistency matters, port this to the same modal treatment used by sos-confirm/sos-cancel.
All 5 headers correctly use paddingTop: insets.top + 6 so nothing gets clipped by the status bar on notch devices; the +6 gives just enough breathing room above the back arrow.

No deprecated Expo packages introduced by this batch (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch touches in the 5 files). No SafeAreaView misuses (all screens use useSafeAreaInsets and manually apply insets to the header, which is the correct pattern for Expo Router).
